name: dll-loader
summary: Make Zone.exe load a companion DLL before its entry point, so features can be written in C/C++ instead of hand-assembled patches.
status: BUILT 2026-09-18, not yet run against a live zone. The import injection is verified structurally (see tools/verify_import.py).
why: Every feature the 2026 content needs from the zone - the void bag (a new ItemBag type), the Corruption
event (a whole new packet department), quest-gated map entry, the 2026 price table - is CODE, not data.
Expressing those as byte edits in this repo does not scale: a recipe can move a constant or repoint a
global, but it cannot add a class, a packet handler or a DB round trip.
So give the zone a DLL and write the features in C++. The loader does the work: an image that imports a
DLL has it mapped and its DllMain run BEFORE the exe entry point, ahead of the CRT, with no code patched.
HOW: the import descriptor array (8 entries, RVA 0x0034ABB4 in .rdata) is COPIED into a new section with
one entry appended for zonehook.dll, and the import data directory is pointed at the copy. The originals
keep their ILT/IAT/name RVAs, which still point into .rdata. Nothing in .text changes.
SAFE because the image has no bound-import directory (checked at apply time and refused otherwise): a
bound image caches resolved addresses and a loader may then skip the descriptor array, silently dropping
the new import. Zone.exe has BoundImport RVA 0 size 0.
ZoneHookInit is imported BY NAME so a missing or mismatched DLL fails loudly at load with a message box
naming the export, instead of leaving a null in an IAT slot nobody calls.
